notes.title: VikingScape Playtest 0.19.1
notes.content:
New:

 New puzzles!
 Added Vsync to options for the game.


Changes

 Updated Hints for items and puzzles.


BugFixes

 Fixed a door that would not open after finnishing the puzzle for it (Causing the game to be softlocked).
 Fixed some spelling errors in the hint menu.
 Fixed Odins Rivver puzzle not always showing the text for when failed.
 Fixed a wall only rendering from one side in spawn.
 General preformence improvements.
 Fixed sewers room wall not rendering to exit.
 Fixed a bugg that caused players fotstepp to be played twice.
